Breaking Bad Actor RJ Mitte Dies at 34

RJ Mitte, an actor known for his role in "Breaking Bad" and as a disability rights advocate, has died at the age of 34. Reports indicate his death was by suicide. Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, had spoken about the challenges of fame and financial difficulties, including allegedly paying more in taxes than he earned from "Breaking Bad" and facing debt due to his financial manager. His co-stars Bryan Cranston and Aaron Paul have mourned his passing.
